# Teracom Solutions

> Australian-owned technology, security and AI company based at 1B Yazaki Way, Carrum Downs VIC 3201, with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. Teracom designs, supplies, installs and supports access control, CCTV and video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercom, audio visual, electrical, automation and networking systems, develops custom software and systems integrations, provides independent technology design and consulting, and builds Teracom AI -- an AI platform for security technicians, engineers, estimators and project teams.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/): overview of Teracom's technology expertise, software and integration development, consulting, hardware supply, installation and support.
- [Teracom AI](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/securityos-ai): AI support agents, scope of works generation, estimation assistance, tender response support, technical design guidance, and training and knowledge tools.
- [Brands](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/brands): the security and technology manufacturers Teracom supplies and works with, including Gallagher, Inner Range, Genetec, Milestone, HID, Axis, Hikvision, Hanwha Vision, Avigilon, Bosch, ASSA ABLOY and Tecom Challenger.
- [Teracom Store](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/store): security products, digital resources, consulting services and Teracom AI subscriptions. Prices shown are RRP including GST; account holders receive additional member discounts.
- [Resources](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/resources): help centre and FAQs, user manuals, datasheets, product videos and downloads.
- [Services](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/services): technology services end to end -- access control, CCTV, intrusion alarms, intercoms, electrical, automation, audio visual, networking, software development, systems integration and development, technology design and consulting, and maintenance and support.
- [Free tools](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/tools): free calculators and tools for engineers, technicians, installers, AV specialists and customers -- CCTV storage, lens and pixel density, network bandwidth, NVR drive/RAID planning, PoE budget, access control power supply, battery standby, cable voltage drop, UPS runtime, 100 V line speaker load, projector throw and IP subnets.
- [Industry news](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/resources/industry-news): the latest Australian security industry headlines from SEN.news.
- [About](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/about): company background, showroom address and opening hours.
- [Contact](https://www.teracomsolutions.com.au/contact): enquiry form, phone, email and showroom location.
